meta.name: firebase-data-connect
meta.description: Builds and deploys Firebase SQL Connect (aka Firebase Data Connect) backends with PostgreSQL securely. Use when designing schemas with tables and relations, writing authorized queries and mutations, configuring real-time data updates, or generating type-safe SDKs. Use when you need a relational database with Firebase, or when the user mentions SQL Connect or Data Connect.

copy.tagline: 用 PostgreSQL 构建并部署 Firebase 数据后端
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Firebase 并需要关系型数据库和类型安全 SDK
copy.tagline_en: Build and deploy Firebase SQL backends with PostgreSQL
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Firebase and need a relational database with type-safe SDKs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 PostgreSQL 设计数据库表、编写查询和变更操作、配置实时数据更新，并生成类型安全的 SDK。
howto.when: 当你需要为 Firebase 项目添加关系型数据库，或提到“SQL Connect”或“Data Connect”时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Firebase SQL Connect 设计一个用户表。
say.note: Claude 会指导你定义 schema。

say.text: 为我的应用生成一个查询所有电影的 GraphQL 操作。
say.note: Claude 会编写 queries.gql 文件。

say.text: 部署我的 SQL Connect 后端到 Cloud SQL。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you design database tables with PostgreSQL, write queries and mutations, configure real-time data updates, and generate type-safe SDKs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a relational database for a Firebase project, or when you mention 'SQL Connect' or 'Data Connect'.

say_en.text: Help me design a user table using Firebase SQL Connect.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through schema definition.

say_en.text: Generate a GraphQL query to list all movies for my app.
say_en.note: Claude will write the queries.gql file.

say_en.text: Deploy my SQL Connect backend to Cloud SQL.
say_en.note: Claude will run the deploy command.
